significance: A hilltop Bhairab temple about 9 km northwest of Tansen in Palpa District, at roughly 1,470 m, established by King Mukunda Sen of the Sena dynasty during the period when Palpa was his capital.
story: Mukunda Sen is said to have carried off an image of Bhairav from the Matsyendranath temple during his attack on Kathmandu and to have installed it here in Palpa.
